githubReleaseAssets: retain until explicit owner deletion; never auto-prune the current or immediately previous formal release
containerImages: immutable SemVer tags; retain the current and immediately previous formal release for api/worker/migrate

rollback.application: reuse the previous formal version artifacts/images only after the U23 compatibility gate accepts the newer schema
rollback.database: if the previous application rejects the newer schema, restore the verified pre-upgrade backup and then restart the previous release
